headline: ADO's shock win over PSV — and why Heerenveen are favourites
summary: ADO Den Haag beat PSV 2-1 on Saturday, described by Yahoo Sports as a stunning result. It is still ADO's only league win, and they sit 17th. On Saturday Heerenveen visit The Hague after beating Excelsior 4-0, a game in which they created chances worth 2.8 goals. ADO create chances worth just 0.96 goals a game, and they conceded 2.86 at Telstar, which is why the market stays with the away side. Heerenveen's win chance is 47.6%, up from 45.3%, against ADO's 27.6%. The handicap rates Heerenveen 0.5 goals better, and the 3.25 goals line points to an open game.
read: Heerenveen arrive off a 4-0 win over Excelsior and are clear favourites at 47.6%, with the handicap line drifting to about 0.4 goals in their favour. ADO Den Haag are 17th with one win in nine — that win was a 2-1 upset of PSV — and their 0.96 xG per game against 1.82 conceded explains why the market still leans away, with a goals line of 3.25 suggesting an open game.

facts.fact: Heerenveen are the favourites at 47.6% against ADO Den Haag's 27.6%.
facts.meaning: The market makes the away side clear favourites at the ground where ADO's only win of the season came.

facts.fact: Heerenveen beat Excelsior 4-0 at home on Friday.
facts.meaning: They arrive scoring freely and with the confidence of a four-goal afternoon.

facts.fact: ADO Den Haag beat PSV 2-1 at home on Saturday, described as a stunning result.
facts.meaning: It is their only league win of the season, and it came against PSV.

facts.fact: ADO Den Haag sit 17th of 18 in the Eredivisie.
facts.meaning: A home game against a top-half side is a scrap near the bottom, not a comfortable fixture.

facts.fact: ADO average 0.96 xG per game across their last five matches.
facts.meaning: They are not creating enough chances to make a home win likely.

facts.fact: ADO conceded 2.86 xG at Telstar on 11 October and still drew 2-2.
facts.meaning: Their points have come on the back of heavy defending, which is why the PSV win did not flip the prices.

facts.fact: The Asian handicap fair line moved from 0.33 to 0.43, with the main line at ADO +0.5.
facts.meaning: The market now rates Heerenveen about 0.4 goals better, so ADO +0.5 is close to a coin flip.

facts.fact: The goals line sits at 3.25 with Over priced at 49.0%.
facts.meaning: The market sees a high-scoring game as roughly a coin flip — three goals and a bit.

sources.fact: ADO Den Haag pulled off a 2-1 upset win over PSV, described as a stunning result, ahead of the Heerenveen match.
ADO Den Haag icon Lex Schoenmaker said after the PSV win that "everyone beats almost everyone," staying happy but level-headed.
ADO face the task of preventing eighth-placed Heerenveen from closing in on the subtop, and can chase a second straight win under Robin Peter.
ADO Den Haag confirmed the signing of 18-year-old forward Eternal Barron on a contract until summer 2027 after he left Ajax as a free agent.
ADO Den Haag signed 16-year-old right winger Joshairo Castelen, who arrived from Heerenveen, until mid-2028.
Heerenveen opened the Eredivisie round with a resounding 4-0 home win over Excelsior.
Bernt Klaverboer called the 4-0 win over Excelsior an evening he will not soon forget, "maybe even never again."
Heerenveen announced before kick-off against Excelsior that Bernt Klaverboer extended to mid-2029 and Nolhan Courtens to mid-2030.
